title: 第610章 危机降临第609章 你们真赶着送死
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“小子，我听柳浮说你之前在万法城，接连斩杀柳家十多个青年子弟，你觉得我们身为柳家之人，能放过你吗？”
微微眯着眼睛，盯着对面的林晨，柳程身上造化境五重的修为爆发出来，神色间都是杀意和怨恨。
之前在古洞府的灵池里面，那么浓郁的天地灵力，他们完全有机会更进一步，却没想到灵力都被灵力吸收过去，导致他们根本无法沉下心神修炼，早就想要对林晨动手。
本想着林晨会死在坍塌的古洞府里，却没想到对方运气这么好，居然能够活着出来。
最重要的是，柳浮承诺过他们，只要能够斩杀林晨，就帮助他们两人去万法城柳家主家当差。
这绝对是柳家任何人，都无法拒绝的条件。
正所谓身在皇城三分贵，一旦进入柳家主家，以后他们所在的分支家族，地位都会跟着提升。
“哦？既然如此，那就别废话，赶紧动手。”
闻言，林晨面色一凝，双眸之中杀意。
“哈哈哈！想不到还有人这么想早点死，我成全你。”
柳程哈哈一笑，身上造化境五重的气势爆发出来，狂风呼啸而过，只见他一步踏出，双手凝聚出巨大的掌印，施展出来的正是柳家地级下品武技“万象归一手”。
掌印弥漫，形成狂暴的气势，从柳程的体内喷薄而出，栖身而上，掌印眨眼间就朝着林晨轰来，笼罩在其中。
呼呼呼！
狂风呼啸，柳程倒是不愧为柳家的弟子，造化境五重的修为，恐怕比嗜血魔教那些造化境七重武者都要强悍不少。
“死！”
脸上弥漫着狰狞之色。
掌印狠狠轰击下来，想要在一招之内解决林晨。
“唉……”
柳终和另外那个造化境一重的男子，眼看着柳程施展出地级下品武技，都忍不住摇摇头，故作叹息。
在他们看来，林晨不过元婴境三重巅峰修为，必死无疑。

眼看着掌印即将轰击在林晨身上之时。
灵力朝着双脚迅速汇聚，林晨猛然朝着身后倒退，紧接着的下一刻，一道一丈多高魁梧的通体赤红的身躯弥漫而出。
嘭！
天灵傀爆发出雄浑的气势，恐怖的威压席卷而来，一拳狠狠砸在柳程下来的掌印之上。
咔嚓声音响起，只见那道狂暴无比的掌印，就从中间不断碎裂，灵力飓风朝着周围涌动。
不等柳程回过神来，天灵傀庞大的身躯冲出去，双拳携带强势的飓风，双脚在地面留下深深的脚印，就砸向柳程。
“啊？这是什么傀儡，为何这么恐怖？”
感受到恐怖的冲击波袭来，柳程猛然回过神来，睚眦欲裂，整个人灵力激荡，疯狂朝着后面逃窜。
可惜，他不过是造化境五重修为，速度又怎么可能赶得上天灵傀，何况在天灵傀出手之前，他本就毫无防备。
嘭！
天灵傀巨石一般的拳头，冲击在柳程的身体之上，咔嚓的声音响彻四周。就见到柳程宛如断线的风筝，接连砸出去十多米开外的地方，鲜血伴随着五脏六腑的碎片，不断从嘴中喷出。
只见那道身影在地上微微蠕动，身上的气息就彻底消散。
“这……”
柳终和董柜万万没想到林晨手中还有这么恐怖的傀儡，这可比之前他们在古洞府里面，遇见的那些傀儡强势太多了。
两人之前脸上轻蔑的神情瞬间消失，身上灵力涌动起来，甚至都没有去管倒在地上的柳程死活，转身就跑。
content_en:
"Boy, I heard from Liu Fu that you were in Wanfa City and killed more than a dozen young men of the Liu family. Do you think we, as members of the Liu family, can let you go?"
Squinting his eyes slightly and staring at Lin Chen opposite him, Liu Cheng's fifth-level cultivation of the Creation Realm burst out, with murderous intent and resentment in his expression.
In the spiritual pool of the ancient cave house, they had every chance to take a step further due to the rich spiritual power of heaven and earth. However, they did not expect that the spiritual power would be absorbed by the spiritual power, which made them unable to concentrate on cultivation at all, and they had long wanted to attack Lin Chen.
He originally thought that Lin Chen would die in the collapsed ancient cave, but he didn't expect that the other party would be so lucky to come out alive.
The most important thing is that Liu Fu promised them that as long as he could kill Lin Chen, he would help the two of them go to work for the head of the Liu family in Wanfa City.
This is definitely an offer that no one in the Liu family can refuse.
As the saying goes, being in the imperial city is very expensive. Once they enter the head of the Liu family, the status of their branch families will also increase accordingly.
"Oh? In that case, stop talking nonsense and do it quickly."
Hearing this, Lin Chen's face hardened, and there was murderous intent in his eyes.
"Hahaha! I never thought there would be someone who wants to die early. I will help you."
Liu Cheng laughed, and the aura of the fifth level of the Creation Realm burst out from his body. A strong wind roared past. He took one step forward and formed huge palm prints with his hands. What he displayed was the Liu family's earth-level low-grade martial arts "All Things Return to One Hand".
The palm prints filled the air, forming a violent aura, spurting out from Liu Cheng's body and perching on him. In the blink of an eye, the palm prints rushed towards Lin Chen and enveloped him.
Hoo ho ho!
The strong wind howled, Liu Cheng was worthy of being a disciple of the Liu family, and his cultivation level at the fifth level of Creation Realm was probably much stronger than those of the Seventh Level Creation Realm warriors from the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect.
"Death!"
There was a ferocious look on his face.
The palm prints struck down hard, trying to kill Lin Chen within one move.
"Alas..."
Liu Zhong and the other man who was at the first level of the Creation Realm couldn't help but shake their heads and pretend to sigh when they saw Liu Cheng performing low-level earth-level martial arts.
In their opinion, Lin Chen was destined to die if he was not at the peak level of the third level of Nascent Soul Realm.
Seeing that the palm print was about to hit Lin Chen.
The spiritual power quickly gathered towards his feet, and Lin Chen suddenly stepped backwards. The next moment, a burly red body over one foot tall appeared out of the air.
Bang!
The Tianling Puppet burst out with a majestic momentum, and the terrifying pressure swept over him, and he punched Liu Cheng's palm mark hard.
There was a clicking sound, and the extremely violent palm print was continuously shattered from the middle, and the hurricane of spiritual power surged around.
Before Liu Cheng could come to his senses, Tianling Puppet's huge body rushed out, carrying a powerful hurricane force in his fists, leaving deep footprints on the ground with his feet, and smashed towards Liu Cheng.
"Ah? What kind of puppet is this? Why is it so scary?"
Feeling the terrifying shock wave coming, Liu Cheng suddenly came back to his senses. His eyes were about to split, his spiritual power surged throughout his body, and he fled back crazily.
It's a pity that he is only at the fifth level of Creation Realm, so how can he be as fast as the Heavenly Spirit Puppet? What's more, he was completely defenseless before the Heavenly Spirit Puppet took action.
Bang!
The Tianling Puppet's boulder-like fist struck Liu Cheng's body, and the clicking sound resounded around him. They saw Liu Cheng flying like a kite with broken strings, more than ten meters away. Blood spurted out of his mouth along with the fragments of his internal organs.
The figure was seen squirming slightly on the ground, and the aura on his body completely dissipated.
"This..."
Liu Zhong and Dong Gui never expected that Lin Chen would have such a terrifying puppet in his hands. This was much more powerful than the puppets they had encountered in the ancient cave before.
The contemptuous expressions on their faces disappeared instantly, and their spiritual energy surged. They didn't even care about the life and death of Liu Cheng, who fell on the ground, and turned around and ran away.
